raw_segments.text: She trusts me, her hand gentle, the long glashed eyes.
Now where the blue hell am I bringing her beyond the veil?
Into the ineluctable modality of the ineluctable visuality.
The virgin at Hodges Figgy's window on Monday looking in for
one of the alphabet books you were going to write.
risked through the braided Jessie of her sunshade.
She lives in Leeson Park with a grief and kick-shaws, a lady of letters.
Talk that to someone else, Stevie, a pick-mute.
Bet she wears those curse of God stays suspenders and yellow stockings,
